scope: First direct MCP arena rolling-handoff trial, not full NAV-EQ acceptance

course_envelope.basis: Bounded spatial observations and a fresh same-player perception snapshot; route cells must be rechecked when the frontier changes
course_envelope.successors: Up to three freshly observed distinct-lane sweeps within the envelope; each requires a verified predecessor checkpoint and exact hash linkage

time_and_measurement.wall_clock_origin: UTC timestamps on MCP and resident receipts
time_and_measurement.resident_clock_origin: Exact clock snapshot in each published frontier

stop_criteria: Any actor, world, source, producer, authority or run identity divergence
Hazard, hostile entity, health loss, manual takeover, boundary uncertainty or failed action checkpoint
Any hidden world or inventory mutation, duplicate effect, late effect or failed frozen numeric limit
claim_ceiling: At most a measured rolling-handoff trial on this installed profile; full NAV-EQ remains specified until every required interruption, reconnect and revoke scenario passes
